regions.merged_text: God bless you this beautiful season -- you and yours. I do hope you are well, as thanks be to God we all are, here at St. Felix. Reading over a pathetic letter this morning that I rec- eived more than a month ago, I was forcefully reminded of an article I had read about a week back on: "Missed Opportunities," which letter brought some very serious thoughts to my mind. The letter was written by a friend of mine whose outstanding courage and perseverence in the face of unbelievable odds and handicaps I have since more than fifteen years admired. It is by one whose earnestness and honesty and really deep thinking has been proven beyond the shadow of an honest or reasonable doubt. And that "poor-guy-friend" of mine and, if you will, possibly one of God's very least brethren," is Dr. A. J. Kraus. in many ways an
